findings.title: Synthetic object authorization failure

confidence.reason: independent fixture reproduction and route trace

findings.root_cause: The API authorizes the session but does not bind the object to the actor.
findings.security_claim: A customer may read only objects belonging to that customer or an allowed tenant.
findings.violated_invariant_or_trust_assumption: object_owner(object) must include actor before profile data is returned
preconditions: user_a and user_b synthetic test identities exist
minimal_trigger_sequence: compare with the user_a owner control
findings.observable_consequence: user_b receives the synthetic user_a profile marker
findings.impact: cross-account disclosure in the synthetic fixture
findings.verification_method: two-context differential API replay, source trace, and owner/non-owner controls

falsification_result.notes: The same existing object was compared across owner and non-owner contexts.

findings.fix_guidance: Enforce object and tenant authorization in the service query before serializing profile data.
findings.coverage_impact: profile object authorization covered; exports remain untested
